meta.note: Hand-authored 2026-08. The top ~90 speakers by line count carry gender/role/register filled from the corpus itself; en is deliberately left empty for the separate names pass. Everything the model must do with control codes is handled by masking (it never sees a backslash) and stated once in BASE_RULES; the removed prose lived in the CACHED prefix at 665 tokens a request and naming raw codes invites the model to invent one. The full research is kept in tl/notes-do-not-translate.md, which is never sent.

アルテシア.role: Protagonist. A Holy Executor (執聖官) of the Imperial Orthodoxy, summoned to the Sofreiman Domain by a letter signed by her father Wolf, who is already dead when she arrives. She investigates his murder across six chapters and is the playable character in every H scene.

Blunt, sarcastic, quick to anger, zero keigo with strangers ("捨てるなら捨てるとハッキリ伝えなさい", "見過ごすと思う窃盗を？", "アンタ、正真正銘最低のクズよ！"). Deduction lines are inner monologue in （）. In H scenes the same voice collapses into slurred kana with dakuten and ♡ ("お゛っ♡", "きもひいい", "イグっ！♡♡♡"). Calls her father パパ, never 父.
アルテシア.note: 42,695 lines / 973 scenes - 60% of the corpus. FEMALE, confirmed everywhere (デカパイ, おっぱい, おまんこ, 娘の私が). Her whole arc is stated by her: 「私はただ『納得』したかったの」. Note the item text 執政官の服(インナーのみ) uses 彼 for the INNER GARMENT, not for her - do not let that flip her pronoun.
